title.narrative: Organising events and communication for Partners for Water Colombia Water and Climate Cooperation

description.narrative: Through the Partners for Water programme, the government of the Netherlands aims to organise an event on the Water and Climate cooperation between the Netherlands and Colombia. The Partners for Water communication agency PINO is responsible for taking the lead in the logistical, communication, and programme preparation of a high-level event in Bogotá on Friday 30 October, marking and advancing the water and climate cooperation between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Colombia under the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the Departamento Nacional de Planeación, executed in large part through the Partners for Water programme.The event should serve both as a celebration of achievements to date and as a strategic platform to engage the incoming Government of Colombia, strengthen relationships, and support a potential renewal of the MoU. The agency is expected to develop a coherent concept and narrative that highlights the impact and future potential of bilateral cooperation across key themes, while fostering dialogue, visibility, and new partnerships. The event has a target audience of max. 150 attendees, including Dutch stakeholders and organising committee.A central element is the development of a communication trajectory leading up to the event, involving Dutch and Colombian stakeholders in preparatory activities, shaping the event and associated communication materials. The communication materials include the production of a high-quality video with project partners that showcases the diversity and results of the cooperation. Close coordination with the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Colombia is required. The agency is requested to also collaborate with a Colombia-based organisation to ensure strong local delivery, contextual relevance, and effective stakeholder engagement.In addition, the agency is tasked with conceptualising and organising a follow-up event in the Netherlands after 30 October, providing a platform for Dutch stakeholders to reflect on outcomes, strengthen networks, and translate international engagement into follow-up actions. This event is intended to be smaller-scale compared to the event in Colombia, estimated to be up to 80 participants.Overall, the ambition is to deliver a high-quality, strategically positioned moment to reflect on the partnership to date and actively contributes to shaping its next phase.
